core_meaning.primary_meaning: Kahlil is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Friend, intimate companion”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Kahlil corresponds to the Arabic form خليل (Arabic root خ ل ل (kh-l-l); خَلِيل (Khalīl)). Its core sense is friend, intimate companion. Kahlil is a variant transliteration of Arabic خَلِيل (Khalīl) 'friend, intimate companion', from the root خ ل ل (kh-l-l); it is a well-documented male given name. The source gloss 'Friend of Allah' is broadly consistent. Same name as kaleel and kalil.
